subject: Connector resiliency & rate-fencing plan for BrightPay integration
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Sam Cooper <sam@brightpay.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-11-22T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Connector resiliency & rate-fencing plan for BrightPay integration

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the call this morning. I pulled together a short plan to make the SDK-based connector resilient during your expected traffic patterns and to simplify the endpoint migration from your current gateway to our dedicated EU pool. Can you confirm the following items so we can finalize the handshake checklist?

Quick asks:
- Peak burst (rps): confirm expected burst QPS and typical sustained QPS.
- Auth: will you use API keys for the connector, or do you want OAuth client credentials?
- Region: confirm target region (we heard eu-west-1 on the call).
- Maintenance windows: any blackout periods for cutover?

Planned mitigations we want to implement on our side (summary):
- Client-side: exponential backoff + jitter, idempotent request keys for retries, per-route circuit breaker (thresholds), and 429/503 handling reading Retry-After.
- Server-side: rate-fencing by API key with burst buckets + sustained limit, short-lived token rotation option if you prefer OAuth, and an autoscaling guard rail for the dedicated pool.
- Migration: parallel-run (shadow) traffic to new endpoint for 48 hours, then progressive cutover (5% -> 25% -> 100%) with automatic fallback to old endpoint on error rate > 2%.

Attached: traffic_profile.csv (sample shape for day/week), sdk-snippets.zip (Node/Go examples).

If you confirm the numbers above, I will loop in our runtime team (Vivek + Vanessa) to produce the final connector checklist.

Best,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: traffic_profile.csv (CSV), sdk-snippets.zip (archive)

From: Sam Cooper <sam@brightpay.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightPay Eng Team <eng@brightpay.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Connector resiliency & rate-fencing plan for BrightPay integration

Monica —

Thanks, this looks good. Quick answers:
- Peak burst: we see short bursts up to ~120 r/s (1–2 minute spikes) and a sustained average around 35 r/s.
- Auth: API keys for now; we may switch to client-credentials OAuth later this quarter.
- Region: yes, eu-west-1 is preferred.
- Maintenance: weekly Saturday window 02:00–04:00 UTC — avoid cutovers then.

Notes: our gateway currently returns standard 429 with Retry-After seconds and includes an X-Client-RateLimit-Remaining header. We can add a small header for idempotency if you need it.

Attached: environment.yaml (current proxy + timeout settings)

Sam
Lead Platform Engineer
BrightPay Inc.

Attachments: environment.yaml (YAML)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sam Cooper <sam@brightpay.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T15:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Connector resiliency & rate-fencing plan for BrightPay integration — proposed checklist

Hi Sam, Monica —

Thanks for the details, Sam. Monica: I drafted the one-page integrator checklist and attached the connector-failsafe-checklist.pdf. Key callouts in the checklist:
- Configure client token bucket: burst 150, refill 35/s.
- Retries: 5 attempts max; exponential backoff with full jitter; obey Retry-After.
- Timeouts: 15s default, 120s idle for streaming.
- Migration: 48h shadow + progressive rollout with automatic rollback on >2% error budget breach.

Operational play: our runtime will set a soft limit for BrightPay API keys at 200 r/s per key on the eu cluster, with an alert runbook that paginates to the on-call when sustained > 80% of that.

Next steps:
- Sam, can your team enable an idempotency header by EOD Friday so our SDK can set idempotency keys for retrying mutating calls?
- Monica / Vivek: I will open a short PR to add the Node/Go snippets into the integrator doc and push to the shared Drive link.

Sam — we will mirror the environment you sent and run a 2-hour shadow test Tuesday 2026-11-30 at 09:00 UTC if that works for you.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Implementation Lead, Integrations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: connector-failsafe-checklist.pdf (PDF)
